verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community user saying they deleted their account (otter-comm-2), which suggests coarse account-level deletion exists. Another commenter notes that Otter retains data in the cloud per its privacy statement (otter-comm-6). No first-party documentation describes retention settings or per-recording deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented retention-period controls, per-recording or per-transcript deletion, admin/org-level retention policies, deletion guarantees (e.g., backups, timelines), and independent corroboration.
